### Mid-term review: Scaling Equitable Governance in Area-Based Conservation (SEGA)

[Role: evaluation lead]{.role}

A mid-term review of IIED's programme scaling the Site-level Assessment of Governance and Equity (SAGE) tool across five countries, with fieldwork in Madagascar and remote data collection elsewhere. It assesses progress against the Theory of Change, verifies outcomes against the OECD-DAC criteria, and looks at how equitable governance is built in at site level, in line with the 30x30 commitments of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
:::
:::

### Monitoring review: habitat restoration for the Niger Delta red colobus

[Role: review lead]{.role}

A review of a Defra-funded conservation project to appraise progress and sharpen its direction. It tested the Theory of Change and its assumptions and verified outcomes against the OECD-DAC criteria, combining document review with key informant interviews and focus group discussions.

### Mid-term review: Global Biodiversity Standard

[Role: co-evaluator]{.role}

A review of Botanic Gardens Conservation International's independent standard for verifying biodiversity outcomes in nature-based restoration, with fieldwork in Kenya and remote data collection in five more countries. It assessed the Theory of Change, verified outcomes, and judged the Standard's rigour and scalability across land, freshwater and coastal restoration.

### [District poverty in Mozambique](mozambique-poverty.qmd)

Small area poverty estimates for all 157 districts, using the 2022–23 Demographic and Health Survey and open geospatial data in spatial Fay-Herriot models, with calibrated uncertainty and a simulation study.

[Read more](mozambique-poverty.qmd), [code](https://github.com/mirrormerelabs/mozambique_sae), [interactive map](https://mirrormerelabs.github.io/mozambique_sae/)
:::
:::

[In progress]{.status}
:::
::: {}
### [Cropland and conflict in Cabo Delgado](cabo-delgado.qmd)

Did armed conflict make farming shrink, relocate or expand? Each year's land use is mapped from Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and Landsat, without a fixed cropland mask, and six conflict-core districts are compared with two low-conflict controls. The method is open and built to transfer to the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan and Ethiopia.

[Read more](cabo-delgado.qmd)
